post_land_default_runtime_update.command:
cd /home/halbritt/git/kicad-route
env -u KICAD_ROUTE_STATE PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=/home/halbritt/git/kicad-route/src /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from kicad_route import cli, common, determinism, installation, sandbox, skills, statemanifest
root = Path('/home/halbritt/git/kicad-route')
assert common.CHECKOUT_ROOT == root and common.STATE == root
reason = sandbox.writer_refusal('update')
if reason:
    raise SystemExit(reason)
common.set_out(root / 'build/agent497-default-install')
with installation.update_lock():
    print('activated:', cli.update_krt([]), flush=True)
    print(skills.sync(cli.KRT_DIR, cli.KRT_VENV), flush=True)
    manifest = statemanifest.read()
    assert statemanifest.verify(manifest) == []
    print('generation:', common.router_generation(), flush=True)
    proof, path = determinism.check(cli, backend='krt', record=True)
    print('repeat proof:', path, proof.get('record_error') or proof['reasons'], flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(1 if proof.get('record_error') else 0 if proof['reproducible'] else 3)
